illustrations_first_printing.note: The 1907 first printing lists twelve plates, not sixteen: it lacks Hector Chiding Paris, The Meeting of Hector and Andromaché, The Embassy of Achilles, Thetis Bringing the Armour, The Gods Descending to Battle, and has Hera commanding the Sun to Set (facing 240), which the 1923 list lacks. Its spelling is Polydamas; the 1923 list's Polydamus is that printing's.
